dialogues.speaker: A notice
dialogues.text: "About the recent sightings of large Rishboland Tigers:"

dialogues.speaker: A notice
dialogues.text: "Please do not loiter around after dark. The Rishboland Tigers are known to be active at night."

dialogues.speaker: A notice
dialogues.text: "Please do not leave any meat in this area. Feeding the tigers is not the correct way to stay safe. Conversely, it may encourage the tigers to stay."
